entries.en: After we heard the gunshot on the[n]other side of the shutters, Futaba[n]said there were no readings left...
Does this mean we'll[n]never meet again...?
I should forget about him, but...
I want to keep our promise.
...I suppose this is something[n]beyond my own control.
The only thing I can do now[n]is wait for Shido's change of[n]heart. I ought to go to sleep...
I do still have that promise with[n]Akechi to duel again someday...
I know Akechi would especially[n]hate having it end with his defeat...
...Still, there's nothing I can do now.
I should probably get to sleep...
